meta.title: WoW Forever collectible quests and secrets
meta.method_note: Fan-site pages could not be fetched directly (network allowlist); facts come from web-search summaries of the cited pages, written in our own words. Where a coordinate came only from an MIT-licensed addon (Whatnot) it is marked as such. No GPL addon data was used.
meta.step_schema: action in accept|turnin|click|use|emote|kill|collect|goto|talk; ids are null when no source gave them.
meta.confidence_rule: high = 2+ sources agree on locations/steps; medium = one good source or partly unverified coordinates; low = sources conflict or availability unconfirmed.
not_included: Holstered Replica Ironforge Air Rifle (Legacy System reward at 15 points, not a quest)
Pouch of Violet Dust (time-limited Twitch drop)
Minfernal, Shaking Egg, Tallstrider Hatchling, Condor Hatchling (plain rare-mob drops: Immolatus in Felwood, Lord Condar in Loch Modan, Strider Clutchmother in Darkshore)
Galestrider mounts (vendor and reputation sources per Wowhead mount guide)

collectibles.name: Cozy Sleeping Bag
collectibles.type_note: Usable camp item (rest in it for +1% XP per minute, up to +3%, outside rested areas). Returned from Season of Discovery. Not confirmed as a Toy Box entry.
collectibles.reward_item_id_note: Not found in sources (the SoD item ID was not verified).
other_rewards: Old Toolbox (12-slot bag) from Stepping Stones (some guides also list a Sturdy Lunchbox)
collectibles.level_note: All six quests require level 14. Horde players are advised 20-30 because of level-30 Alliance guards at Stonewrought Dam.

quests.name: ...and that note you found
quests.end: Burned-Out Remains (burnt tower south of Camp Taurajo)

quests.name: ...and that note you found
quests.start: Burned-Out Remains (burnt tower south of Camp Taurajo)

quests.name: Stepping Stones
quests.start: Burned-Out Remains where you turned in step 1 (Barrens for Alliance, Westfall for Horde)
quests.start_note: Start point is reported inconsistently (Nailed Plank in Westfall, burnt debris in the Barrens); it follows the turn-in of step 1.
quests.end: Pocket Litter (box at an abandoned camp NE of Sun Rock Retreat)

quests.name: Scramble
quests.end: Mound of Dirt (ledge below the camp; jump down from the hill)

quests.name: Wet Job
quests.level_note: 32 per Icy Veins DB, 40 per Warcraft Wiki
quests.end: Eagle Figurine / Carved Figurine on the carved dwarf heads below the top of Stonewrought Dam

quests.name: Eagle's Fist
quests.level_note: 32 per Icy Veins DB, 40 per Warcraft Wiki
quests.end: Messenger Bag hanging on Thoradin's Wall

quests.name: This Must Be The Place
quests.end: Hastily Rolled-Up Satchel (just below the Messenger Bag)

quests.name: Rekindle
quests.note: Optional side quest using the Flint and Wood from the chain (single source).

steps.note: Alliance start: cart wreckage at Alexston Farmstead. Accept '...and that note you found'.
Horde start: burnt tower south of Camp Taurajo. Accept '...and that note you found'.
Alliance hands in '...and that note you found' here, then accepts Stepping Stones from the same remains.
Horde hands in '...and that note you found' here, then accepts Stepping Stones from the same remains.
From the remains where you just turned in (Barrens for Alliance, Westfall for Horde).

steps.target: Abandoned camp NE of Sun Rock Retreat
steps.note: Mountain trail entrance; follow it up to the camp.
Hand in Stepping Stones (Old Toolbox reward) and accept Scramble.
Jump from the hill north of the camp down onto the ledge. Hand in Scramble, accept Wet Job.
Walk out on Stonewrought Dam, face north toward the Wetlands and drop onto the carved dwarf heads; the figurine is on the easternmost head. Level-30 Alliance guards nearby.

steps.target: Broken cart at the foot of Thoradin's Wall
steps.note: Climb in via the cart on the Hillsbrad side, follow the jumps to the camp on the wall, go through the room and look right/outside.
Hand in Eagle's Fist, accept This Must Be The Place.

alt.note: same spot as seen on the Hillsbrad map (approach point)

steps.note: Hangs just under the Messenger Bag. Completing it awards the Cozy Sleeping Bag.

collectibles.notes: The Messenger Bag's exact spot is the least consistent point (Arathi map 22.4-22.5, 24.1-24.2 vs Hillsbrad 87.3-87.4, 49.6 approach).

collectibles.name: Night Watchman's Torch
collectibles.faction_note: Both factions (Wowhead 'Side: Both'); Horde access was fixed on 15 Oct. Metaforge lists it as Alliance-only (outlier).

quests.name: An Unfortunate End
quests.note: Second ID listed by bindonforever/kovarel as an Alliance version; unverified.

steps.note: Most reported spot: behind the biggest building at Raven Hill, next to the outhouse. The body rotates between 6-9 spots; one source says it only appears at night (after 20:00 game time).

alt.note: top of Raven Hill Cemetery among level-25 ghouls

steps.note: Offered by the body.
Hand it straight back in to the same body; the torch goes to your bags.
Cosmetic light for 5 minutes, 30 s cooldown; not usable in cities; goes out when you enter combat or swim.

collectibles.notes: Quest ID is solid; the spawn location rotates and sources list different sets of points, so treat coordinates as a search list.

collectibles.name: Prairie Chicken
collectibles.reward_item_note: Reward is a Chicken Egg that teaches the pet (now a spell, no bag slot). Classic item ID for the egg was not confirmed by sources.
collectibles.faction_note: Only Alliance can complete CLUCK!; Horde may loot an egg spawned by an Alliance player's quest (old reports, not verified in Forever).

steps.note: Saldean's Farm. Buy at least one Special Chicken Feed.
Target a chicken and repeat /chicken until it turns friendly (green name) and offers CLUCK!. Number of tries varies.
/cheer at it before handing in the feed.
Give the Special Chicken Feed.
Loot the egg that spawns next to the chicken (bind on pickup); onlookers have reportedly sniped eggs.
Learns the Prairie Chicken companion.

collectibles.notes: No source gave Farmer Saldean's Forever coordinates. wowforever.be also mentions a 'Farm Chicken Egg' world-drop source (conflict).

collectibles.name: Sprite Darter Hatchling
collectibles.faction_note: Quest chain is Alliance-only. Horde alternative: Sprite Darters (level 43-45, western Feralas) drop it at about 2.7%.
collectibles.level_note: Chain quests are level 47-48; Freedom for All Creatures and The Newest Member of the Family require 38. One source lists Becoming a Parent as requiring 41.

steps.note: From Kindal Moonweaver on a ledge behind the Grimtotem Compound (go left of the compound, up the path behind a tree).
Free the Sprite Darters from the Grimtotem pen; at least 6 darters and Kindal must survive; 6-minute timer. A partner helps.
Kindal Moonweaver.
From Jer'kai Moonweaver (Kindal's sister).

steps.target: 12 Grimtotem Naturalists, 10 Grimtotem Raiders, 6 Grimtotem Shamans

steps.note: Jer'kai Moonweaver.
Part 2: take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to Darnassus.
High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

steps.target: An Orphan Looking For a Home
steps.note: From Kindal Moonweaver after Doling Justice.

steps.target: An Orphan Looking For a Home
steps.note: Quentin at the Shimmering Flats.
Quentin wants 2 Elixirs of (Lesser) Fortitude; bring them along to do it in one go.

steps.target: The Newest Member of the Family
steps.note: 1-hour timer: carry the Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to Agnar Beastamer.

steps.target: The Newest Member of the Family
steps.note: Agnar Beastamer, Wildhammer Keep at Aerie Peak.
Agnar Beastamer: bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks.
Reward: Sprite Darter Egg.

collectibles.notes: Quest IDs 2969, 2970, 2972, 3841, 3842, 3843, 4298 are named by Forever databases; 4297 (Food for Baby) is the Classic ID and was not shown by a Forever source. Wowhead's retail PTR marks the chain obsolete, but Forever databases list it as live. Agnar Beastamer's coordinates were not found.

collectibles.name: Alcaz Operative Insignia
collectibles.effect: Defias operative disguise for 10 minutes, 30-minute cooldown; learned account-wide (Wowhead).
collectibles.level_note: Dungeon and follow-up quests are level 53, require 48. Fractured Insignia requires level 40.

steps.note: Clear the dungeon but leave the first boss, The Questioner, alive. Killing him first locks the run out of the quest.
Prisoner in chains at the end of Alcaz Prison.

steps.target: The Man in the Iron Chains
steps.note: From Mason Connery.
Loot the shackle key (Ornate/Alcaz Shackle Key).

steps.target: The Man in the Iron Chains
steps.note: Free Mason Connery.
Mason gives a note pointing to Moonbrook.
Moonbrook inn, second floor, middle room, corner floorboard. Completes More Valuable Than Gold and gives the Document Box (do not vendor it).
Starts State Secrets.
Alliance: Renzik 'The Shiv' in Stormwind City. Horde: Nazgrel in Orgrimmar (quest 96376). Neutral: Rix Xizzix in Booty Bay. Reward: 1 Fractured Insignia.
One per character (quest is not repeatable); the insignia is tradeable, so the rest can come from alts, friends or the Auction House.
Combines into the Alcaz Operative Insignia toy.

quests.name: The Man in the Iron Chains
State Secrets
quests.note: Alliance (Renzik) and neutral (Rix Xizzix) versions exist with unknown IDs.

collectibles.name: Excitable Slime
collectibles.faction_note: No faction flag on the quest per one guide, but everything happens in Undercity, so it is Horde in practice; databases list the quest as Horde.

steps.note: Sludge vendor.
It patrols the green canal. Stand on solid ground (canal steps); emotes while swimming do not work.

alt.note: NPC ID 269452 seen only inside a cited URL; unconfirmed

steps.note: Target it and /dance repeatedly until it emotes back and offers the quest.
Hand over 1 Nutritious Slime Sludge.
Use the pet item to learn it.

collectibles.name: Musical Gustjumper
collectibles.faction_note: Zephras Isle (Skyborne start zone); Horde reach it by zeppelin from Mulgore, Alliance by boat from north Dalaran.

steps.target: Frogs on a rock near the top of the waterfall

steps.note: Target one of the frogs and /sing.

steps.target: Musical Gustjumper (frog that hops onto the log)
steps.note: One frog hops onto a log next to you; right-click it to pick it up.
Learn the pet. Not soulbound until collected; reports differ on whether you can get extras.

collectibles.name: Truthseeker's Bow
collectibles.type_note: Rare bow (ilvl 45, +7 Agi, +3 Sta, binds on pickup); requires level 40 since the 8 Oct patch (no requirement during beta).
collectibles.level_note: The 25-book quest requires 35 (Out of Games, wowcalc) or 30 (most guides); the bow itself needs level 40.

steps.note: Loot 25 different books.

steps.target: Each book's quest at your librarian
steps.note: Alliance: Garion Wendell. Horde: Owen Thadd, Undercity 74.0, 32.4. The 8 level-60 books go to the mage trainer next to them.

steps.target: Greater Friend of the Library (20 books, level 20)
Greater Friend of the Library (25 books)

steps.note: Choose Truthseeker's Bow (alternatives: Crest of Elucidation, Researcher's Night Light).

collectibles.name: Dawn Waker (Eluvi'ana)
collectibles.type_note: Secret chain. Confirmed reward so far: Eluvi'ana, a rare one-hand sword (ilvl 15, unique, soulbound). The chain continues but its end (a twin blade, Eluvi'tor) is unsolved as of late Nov 2026.
collectibles.faction_note: Both factions; the water-globe step differs by faction.
collectibles.level_note: Part 1 (sword) is low level; Wowhead suggests 40+ for the whole chain; later steps are level 45-60 content.

steps.note: Thendal Village, top floor of the building. Skyborne characters get it from the quest Coming of Age instead. Wear it: it reveals elven spirits and hidden vaults.
See the Night Watchman's Torch entry (quest 98372).
Back of the Ruins of Ban'aethal: light the torch to reveal the Ancient Hilt. World boss Altairus is close; pull him away and let him reset, no need to kill him.
Starts 'The Ancient Hilt' (ID from one database).
Near Valanaar. Give her the hilt (keep it).
Spawn point moves; reported spots listed in alt.
Returns Eluvi'ana. You can stop here if you only want the sword.

steps.target: Baron Marinous (summoned at the Fathom Stone)
steps.note: Alliance route to the globe: summon him, loot the Clouded Water Globe.
Grove of the Ancients: hand in the globe, then talk to Onu again to receive the Befouled Water Globe (item 282337). The extra conversation is required.
Horde route: Zoram'gar Outpost. Kill Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom Deeps for the Strange Water Globe, hand it in, then talk again for the Befouled Water Globe.
Zoram Strand, with the ring equipped and the globe in bags.
Top of the Tower of Althalaxx; loot the Azsharan Key and open Narassin's Strongbox for Narassin's Tome, then return to the spirit.
Reported zone 'Shen'dralar' (Evenshade's Overlook); he names three cleansing materials. Talk before gathering. Zone name not confirmed by a second source.

steps.target: Shen'dralar Vault switches + vault (Star of Elune)
steps.note: Ruins of Isildien, ring equipped. Five players: four press hidden switches within ~15 s of each other at 58.5,71.0 / 57.3,71.7 / 59.7,72.0 / 61.1,73.6 while the fifth loots the Star of Elune.
Underwater chest; no coordinates in web sources (an MIT addon lists 66.0, 54.1 via the Kirith/Azsharite chain).

steps.target: Anguished / Suffering Highborne (20 Tears of Anguish)
steps.note: Lake Kel'Theril ghosts, about level 55; drops not guaranteed.
Shrine of Coalescence with the Star, the Mote and the tears: creates the Cleansed Water Globe.
Show him the Cleansed Water Globe; he sends you to Prince Tortheldrin.
Dire Maul west wing. He speaks of Eluvi'ana and its twin Eluvi'tor and hints that Honored with his court is needed; one player at Honored saw no new dialogue. End of the known trail.

collectibles.notes: Steps up to Tortheldrin are well documented; the final reward is unknown. Mordent's zone label and the Azshara/Winterspring coordinates are single-source.

collectibles.name: Replica Dartol's Rod of Transformation
collectibles.effect: Turns you into a furbolg (Forever toy version of the Raene's Cleansing rod; the quest rod is removed at the final turn-in).

steps.note: Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. Eleven-part chain; several parts share the same name. First part is quest 1028 on Wowhead Classic.
Lake Falathim; search for the Glowing Gem (random, may take several tries).
Moonwell east of Iris Lake; give her the gem.
Treants drop the Wooden Key; near the Felwood border.
Appears after killing the Rotting Slimes.
Enchant the rebuilt rod, then interact again for the next quest.
Mystral Lake; take the temporary rod to Raene first, then use it to speak with Krolg.
Tough elite; loot his skull.
Bring the skull and quest rod to Raene; reward is the Replica Dartol's Rod toy.

collectibles.notes: Reward mechanic and Alliance-only status agree across sources. Step coordinates come from Classic-era data (via an MIT addon) and were not re-verified on Forever; step order beyond the outline is from forg.gg's list.

collectibles.name: Everlasting Silvermoon Shimmerwine
collectibles.effect: Hold up a glass of wine.
collectibles.faction_note: One guide calls it an Alliance quest; not confirmed elsewhere.

steps.note: Arille Azuregaze in the City of Dalaran (coordinates given on the Alterac Mountains map; some sites label the zone Dalaran).
Drops from Blood Elf Reclaimers, Surveyors, Defenders and Arcanists.
Reward: the toy plus a choice of Shimmerwine Shanker or Shimmerwine Spirits.

collectibles.name: Weevil K. Neevil

steps.note: Giver reported as Amaryllis Webb (single source).
Catch an Arbor Tarantula, a Hay Weevil Specimen and a Flesh Picker (locations not given by sources).
Reward: Weevil K. Neevil (data marks it account-wide; unconfirmed).

collectibles.notes: Quest exists in the Forever database; beta reports on its availability were inconsistent.

steps.note: Level 50 rare (elite on beta) crocolisk patrolling the canals; groups/raids have been used. Drop rate unknown (one beta figure 88.6%).

collectibles.name: Reins of the Pack Kodo

steps.note: Forever-only currency from the trade-supply factions (Azeroth Commerce Authority / Durotar Supply and Logistics).
Three Corners.

collectibles.requirements_note: Level 60 and Journeyman Riding. Whether Exalted with the supply faction is required is disputed (boost sites say yes; one guide says Exalted gates the tabard instead).
